title: Light Cap
description:
Background: Designed by Demna and his team, the Light Cap was likely made for Homeless People to see at night, as written down in Ye's notes for the Photoshoot, when the collection was initially being designed to be given out to the Homeless. The Cap never made it to production, likely due to the homeless idea being scrapped. Although Demna would revisit the idea for Balenciaga's Fall 23 Collection and release an LED Light Cap.

It was in 2 looks for the YGEBB Lookbook; one was used, and the Cap was edited out, and the other look was not used.
